body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Sony showcased its 64GB HD Handycam camcorder 'HDR-CX550V' at CES 2010.

It features 1920 x 1080 Full HD video recording, 12-megapixel images, 64GB embedded Flash memory and also equipped with an Exmor R CMOS sensor, wide-angle G Less, 10X optical zoom, Optical SteadyShot, built-in GPS receiver.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
